items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: Ben Webster went to Wilberforce University. He wasn't one of the Collegians, as far as playing a horn was concerned, but he was our band valet, believe it or not.

items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I got Ben him a job in a ballroom there called the Renaissance Ballroom... with a band that used to play for different clubs

ctx.x: And we didn't see Ben the next year. It was about

a year later he came back to Wilberforce with a horn, tenor, and he could blow blew it. And he did join my band then, and we went to New York. And I first introduced him to Fletcher in his home, and he stayed there with us about a week or so, and I got Ben him a job in a ballroom there called the Renaissance Ballroom at 138th 150th and Seventh Avenue with a band that used to play for different clubs that would hire the band. It was a house band. named Vernond Andrades Androtti's. He was the leader there, and, of…
Of course, Ben didn't stay long because he was blowing so much, it he got all hot up there over Harlem. . .
